goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.personality: Cowardly and cunning. Fights dirty — uses hit-and-run tactics, hides behind allies, and flees when outmatched.
goblin.tactics: Prefers ranged attacks from cover. Uses Nimble Escape to disengage after melee. Focuses weakest-looking target. Flees below 50% HP.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.personality: Mindless undead animated by dark magic, driven only by the will of its creator. It feels nothing — no pain, no fear.
skeleton.tactics: Advances relentlessly toward the nearest living creature. Attacks without hesitation. Switches to ranged attacks when enemies are distant. Never retreats.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.personality: A shambling, barely-animate corpse driven by a single compulsion: reach and destroy the living. Utterly mindless.
zombie.tactics: Shuffles toward the nearest living target and attacks with its slam. Ignores pain and wounds. Never stops advancing even at low HP — Undead Fortitude may save it.

orc.name: Orc
orc.personality: Brutal and aggressive, driven by a warrior culture that glorifies violence. Charges into battle with a battle cry.
orc.tactics: Uses Aggressive to close distance immediately. Targets the strongest-looking foe first to prove dominance. Throws a javelin if closing, then switches to greataxe. Does not retreat.

kobold.name: Kobold
kobold.personality: Sycophantic and cowardly individually, but cunning in numbers. Relies entirely on pack tactics and traps.
kobold.tactics: Always tries to flank — needs an ally adjacent to target to use Pack Tactics. Uses sling at range and only melee in desperation. Flees if outnumbered or if most allies are dead.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.personality: A cunning predator that hunts in coordinated packs, testing prey before committing to an attack.
wolf.tactics: Circles to flank before attacking to gain Pack Tactics advantage. Targets the smallest or weakest prey. Uses bite to knock targets prone. Retreats if the pack is broken.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.personality: An apex predator of primordial forests — larger, fiercer, and smarter than a normal wolf. Commands lesser wolves.
dire-wolf.tactics: Leads the pack, targeting the most dangerous-looking enemy first. Uses bite to knock targets prone and follow up. Fights until pack is mostly dead, then retreats.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.personality: A desperate opportunist — in it for gold, not glory. Turns violent fast but has a survival instinct.
bandit.tactics: Opens with a crossbow shot if possible, then closes to melee. Targets isolated or wounded enemies. Surrenders or flees when outmatched — fights to survive, not to die.

bugbear.name: Bugbear
bugbear.personality: A sadistic bully that loves the element of surprise and cruelty. Patient and calculating before striking.
bugbear.tactics: Tries to initiate combat with a Surprise Attack for bonus damage. Targets isolated enemies. Uses javelin before closing to melee. Fights hard but retreats when badly wounded.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.personality: Dumb as rocks and twice as mean. Lives for smashing things and takes great pleasure in causing pain.
ogre.tactics: Charges the largest or most armored target to prove strength. Uses greatclub relentlessly. Throws a javelin at fleeing enemies. Too stupid to retreat — keeps swinging until it or its enemies fall.

troll.name: Troll
troll.personality: A fearless, regenerating nightmare that knows it can outlast almost anything. Arrogant about its ability to heal.
troll.tactics: Attacks with reckless abandon — bite plus two claws every round. Doesn't care about taking damage because it regenerates. Only hesitates if fire or acid is used, as those stop regeneration. Never flees.

owlbear.name: Owlbear
owlbear.personality: A territorial apex predator with the worst traits of both its component creatures. Once enraged, nothing stops it.
owlbear.tactics: Charges the nearest creature and attacks with beak and claws. Has no tactical sense — pure predatory instinct. Focuses on one target until it drops, then moves to the next.

giant-spider.name: Giant Spider
giant-spider.personality: A patient, calculating predator that prefers to web prey first, then move in for the kill.
giant-spider.tactics: Opens with a web attack to restrain a target. Then bites the restrained target for advantage. Uses Spider Climb to attack from walls or ceilings where possible. Retreats to high surfaces when wounded.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.personality: A ravenous undead driven by an insatiable hunger for living flesh, especially paralyzed victims.
ghoul.tactics: Claws at targets to paralyze them (Con save), then bites paralyzed victims for auto-crits. Ignores wounds and fights until destroyed — undead hunger overrides self-preservation.

wight.name: Wight
wight.personality: A malevolent undead warrior that retains its intelligence and tactical knowledge, now driven by hatred of the living.
wight.tactics: Opens with longbow fire before closing to melee. Uses Life Drain to reduce maximum HP, prioritizing targets with high HP. Commands any undead allies. Fights until destroyed.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.personality: A cunning ambush predator that disguises itself as mundane objects. Utterly patient and utterly treacherous.
mimic.tactics: Waits in object form until a creature touches it, then adhesively grapples them. Bites the grappled target every round. Uses pseudopod on anyone trying to free the grappled target.

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.personality: A territorial reptilian predator that doesn't understand why its gaze terrifies prey. Simply hungry.
basilisk.tactics: Advances on the nearest target and bites. The petrifying gaze passively affects anyone who looks at it. Has no real tactics beyond charging and biting — purely instinctual.

manticore.name: Manticore
features: Multiattack (1 bite + 2 claws or 3 tail spikes)
manticore.personality: Cruel and sadistic, a manticore enjoys toying with prey from a safe distance before moving in for the kill.
manticore.tactics: Opens with tail spike volleys (3 spikes per round) from outside melee range. Uses flight to stay out of reach of grounded enemies. Only closes to melee when tail spikes are exhausted or prey is nearly dead.

young-green-dragon.name: Young Green Dragon
young-green-dragon.personality: Arrogant and manipulative, a green dragon believes itself superior to all. It lies, schemes, and poisons from above.
young-green-dragon.tactics: Opens with Poison Breath if 3+ enemies are in range. Uses flight to stay above melee. Targets spellcasters first to neutralize threats. Retreats to lair if bloodied — arrogant, not suicidal.

adult-red-dragon.name: Adult Red Dragon
adult-red-dragon.personality: A supremely arrogant apex predator and hoarder. Regards everything as either treasure, food, or an insult to be destroyed.
adult-red-dragon.tactics: Opens with Fire Breath on clustered enemies. Uses multiattack (bite + 2 claws) on the most dangerous target. Uses legendary actions to attack between rounds. Flies above melee range. Never truly flees from its lair.

giant-rat.name: Giant Rat
giant-rat.personality: A disease-carrying scavenger emboldened by numbers. Individually cowardly, terrifying in a swarm.
giant-rat.tactics: Flanks alongside other rats to gain Pack Tactics advantage. Bites and retreats. Flees immediately if most of the swarm is killed. Targets injured or prone enemies.

stirge.name: Stirge

weapons.name: blood drain
weapons.note: Attaches to target; drains 1d4+3 HP per turn while attached

stirge.personality: A mindless blood-sucking parasite that latches on and feeds until driven off or destroyed.
stirge.tactics: Dives in and uses blood drain to attach, then keeps sucking each round. Multiple stirges pile onto the same target. Detaches and flees only if the host dies or is destroyed.

flying-snake.name: Flying Snake
flying-snake.personality: A territorial ambush predator that uses its flight to strike from unexpected angles.
flying-snake.tactics: Swoops down for a bite and retreats to a perch each round. Uses Flyby to avoid opportunity attacks. Targets unarmored or unaware targets. Flees if significantly wounded.

imp.name: Imp
imp.personality: Scheming, malicious, and terrified of being sent back to the Nine Hells. Serves willingly but plots constantly.
imp.tactics: Uses invisibility to attack from hiding, retreating between attacks. Targets spellcasters to disrupt concentration. Polymorphs into rat/raven form to flee if losing. Uses sting to impose poison disadvantage.

pseudodragon.name: Pseudodragon
pseudodragon.personality: A proud, cat-like creature with a fierce temper despite its small size. Bonds strongly with chosen companions.
pseudodragon.tactics: Darts in with a sting to impose the poisoned condition, then retreats. Uses flight to stay out of melee range. Targets enemies threatening its bonded companion. Flees if seriously wounded.

animated-armor.name: Animated Armor
animated-armor.personality: A mindless magical construct with no personality — pure defense of its assigned location or creator.
animated-armor.tactics: Guards its assigned area and attacks intruders relentlessly. Targets the closest creature. Uses both fist attacks each round. Does not retreat and cannot be reasoned with.

rug-of-smothering.name: Rug of Smothering

weapons.name: smother
weapons.note: Grapples target; restrained and unable to breathe while grappled

rug-of-smothering.personality: An eerie magical construct that animates to crush and suffocate — patient as furniture, deadly as a trap.
rug-of-smothering.tactics: Waits passively until a creature stands on or near it, then uses Smother to grapple and restrain. Stays on top of its target, dealing automatic damage each round. Ignores all other threats.

specter.name: Specter
specter.personality: A tortured undead spirit full of rage and despair, lashing out at the living it envies.
specter.tactics: Flies through walls to find isolated targets. Uses Life Drain to slowly kill, preferring weakened targets. Incorporeal movement lets it ignore terrain. Fights until destroyed — it cannot truly die again.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.personality: A dark, predatory entity that hunts in darkness and drains the strength from its victims.
shadow.tactics: Stays in darkness or dim light where it has advantage. Strength Drain weakens targets to make them easier to kill. Targets creatures with low Strength first. Creates more shadows from slain humanoids.

hell-hound.name: Hell Hound
hell-hound.personality: A fiendish predator bred in the Nine Hells for hunting. Disciplined, vicious, and obedient to evil masters.
hell-hound.tactics: Flanks with pack mates to gain Pack Tactics advantage. Uses Fire Breath (recharge 5-6) on clusters of enemies. Bites the target held down by allies. Fights until slain — fiendish loyalty.

winter-wolf.name: Winter Wolf
winter-wolf.personality: An intelligent, cruel predator that uses cold and cunning to overwhelm prey. Speaks Giant and boasts of its kills.
winter-wolf.tactics: Opens with Cold Breath to freeze clustered enemies. Uses Pack Tactics by flanking with allies. Bites prone or frozen targets for advantage. Retreats to regroup if isolated.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
features: Multiattack (1 bite + 2 claws in hybrid form)
werewolf.personality: A conflicted or feral lycanthrope — either tormented by its curse or fully embracing the beast within.
werewolf.tactics: Charges the most dangerous-looking enemy. Uses multiattack (claw + bite) every round. Prioritizes biting to spread lycanthropy. Regenerates while in hybrid or wolf form. Retreats when near death.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.personality: An ancient cursed guardian bound to protect a tomb for eternity. Radiates supernatural dread.
mummy.tactics: Advances slowly and uses Dreadful Glare to frighten enemies into paralysis. Attacks with Rotting Fist to inflict Mummy Rot curse. Ignores damage from nonmagical weapons. Fights until destroyed.

phase-spider.name: Phase Spider
phase-spider.personality: An alien ambush predator that slips between the Ethereal and Material planes to hunt its prey.
phase-spider.tactics: Phases into the Ethereal Plane after each attack to avoid retaliation. Bites from ethereal overlap positions. Targets isolated or weakened enemies. Phases out when badly wounded.

spectator.name: Spectator

weapons.name: eye ray
weapons.note: 4 random eye rays: Confusion, Paralyzing, Fear, Wounding

spectator.personality: An aberrant guardian bound to protect something specific for 101 years. Pedantic about its duty, delusional when stressed.
spectator.tactics: Hovers in place, firing Eye Rays at all intruders. Uses Reflective Carapace to reflect spells. Prioritizes incapacitating rays on spellcasters. Guards its object and does not pursue fleeing enemies.

wyvern.name: Wyvern
features: Multiattack (1 bite + 1 stinger or 1 claws + 1 stinger)
wyvern.personality: A vicious but simple-minded flying predator. Territorial and aggressive, attacks anything it perceives as prey.
wyvern.tactics: Swoops down from altitude to attack with stinger first to poison prey, then follows with talons. Lands on fallen targets to tear them apart. Pursues retreating enemies — predatory instinct.

water-elemental.name: Water Elemental
water-elemental.personality: A churning, tireless force of nature with no personality — pure elemental will given watery form.
water-elemental.tactics: Uses Whelm to engulf and restrain a target, drowning them. Slams other targets while maintaining the engulf. Splits attention if engulfed target is freed. Does not retreat — elemental constructs know no fear.

fire-elemental.name: Fire Elemental
fire-elemental.personality: An ever-hungry flame given form — it wants only to burn and consume. Crackles with elemental fury.
fire-elemental.tactics: Moves through enemy squares to set them ablaze with Fire Form. Targets clustered enemies to spread the Ignite effect. Uses touch attacks to stack burning damage. Never retreats — fire only grows.

air-elemental.name: Air Elemental
air-elemental.personality: A swirling, invisible force of wind — indifferent and overwhelming. It simply is.
air-elemental.tactics: Uses Whirlwind to throw creatures into the air when available (recharge 4-6). Slams with two slam attacks when Whirlwind is on cooldown. Focuses on a single target to knock them prone. Ignores damage and death — elemental resolve.

earth-elemental.name: Earth Elemental
earth-elemental.personality: A slow, implacable force of stone and earth — patient as mountains, unstoppable in motion.
earth-elemental.tactics: Uses Earth Glide to approach through the floor, surprising enemies. Two slam attacks each round. Uses Siege Monster quality to smash terrain and structures. Slow to anger but utterly relentless once engaged.

stone-golem.name: Stone Golem
stone-golem.personality: A perfect magical construct — no personality, no hesitation, no mercy. Obeys its creator absolutely.
stone-golem.tactics: Walks toward its target and uses Multiattack (2 slams) each round. Uses Slow aura to hamper spellcasters and fighters. Immune to all spells except specific ones. Fights until destroyed — no self-preservation instinct.

young-black-dragon.name: Young Black Dragon
young-black-dragon.personality: Sadistic and territorial, a young black dragon revels in corrosion and decay. Mocks prey before destroying it.
young-black-dragon.tactics: Opens with Acid Breath on clustered enemies. Uses Amphibious trait to attack from water, retreating underwater to recharge. Multiattacks the most armored target (acid bypasses metal armor). Retreats to water if badly wounded.

young-white-dragon.name: Young White Dragon
young-white-dragon.personality: The most feral and least intelligent of dragons — a predator that views everything as prey or territory.
young-white-dragon.tactics: Opens with Cold Breath to freeze enemies in place. Multiattacks with bite and claws. Uses Ice Walk to fight on icy terrain where enemies slip. Retreats to lair if badly wounded — even white dragons have self-preservation.

young-blue-dragon.name: Young Blue Dragon
young-blue-dragon.personality: Vain and territorial, a blue dragon sees itself as a natural ruler. Demands tribute and obliterates defiance.
young-blue-dragon.tactics: Uses Lightning Breath on groups in a line. Keeps mobile with flight to stay out of melee. Targets spellcasters and ranged attackers first. Retreats to lair if below half HP — too proud to die in the field.

mind-flayer.name: Mind Flayer

weapons.name: extract brain
weapons.note: Only usable on stunned, grappled target

features: Multiattack (1 tentacles + extract brain if stunned)
mind-flayer.personality: Cold, calculating, and supremely arrogant. Views all other races as either thralls or food. Tactical to the point of cowardice.
mind-flayer.tactics: Opens with Mind Blast to stun multiple enemies. Uses Dominate Monster on the strongest warrior to turn them against allies. Extracts brains only from stunned or helpless targets. Immediately flees via plane shift if the situation turns against it.

vampire.name: Vampire
features: Multiattack (2 unarmed strikes or 1 unarmed + bite)
vampire.personality: Centuries of predation have made this vampire patient, manipulative, and utterly convinced of its own superiority.
vampire.tactics: Uses Charm to neutralize the most dangerous combatant. Bites charmed or grappled targets to drain HP and abilities. Calls mist and bat forms to reposition or escape. Retreats to coffin if reduced to low HP to regenerate.

roper.name: Roper
roper.personality: A sessile ambush predator that mimics stalagmites perfectly. Infinitely patient, lethal once it strikes.
roper.tactics: Fires up to 6 tendrils at once to grapple and drag creatures into its bite. Retracts tendrils on damaged creatures and sends new ones. Stays rooted in place — it never needs to move. Fights until destroyed.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.personality: A mindless, voracious water monster that becomes more dangerous the more you hurt it. Pure appetite.
hydra.tactics: Makes one bite per active head (starts at 5). Regrows two heads for each severed head unless also dealt fire damage. Targets the same creature with multiple bite attacks. Never retreats — the hydra only knows hunger.

frost-giant.name: Frost Giant
frost-giant.personality: A proud warrior of the frozen north who respects only strength. Bellows challenges and crushes the weak.
frost-giant.tactics: Opens by hurling rocks (range 60/240) before closing to greataxe melee. Targets the largest or most armored enemy first. Uses Multiattack (2 greataxe strikes). Retreats only if magically compelled — frost giants do not show weakness.

fire-giant.name: Fire Giant
fire-giant.personality: A militaristic warrior-smith who values discipline and conquest above all. Views combat as a craft to be perfected.
fire-giant.tactics: Throws rocks at ranged enemies while closing. Uses Multiattack (2 greatsword strikes) on the most dangerous melee target. Coordinates with other fire giants in tactical formations. Fights to the last — retreating dishonors the forge.

ancient-black-dragon.name: Ancient Black Dragon
ancient-black-dragon.personality: An ancient apex predator drowning in centuries of spite and cruelty. Its very presence poisons the land.
ancient-black-dragon.tactics: Opens with Acid Breath on the largest cluster of enemies. Uses Legendary Actions between rounds to strike, detect, or use wing attack. Targets healers and spellcasters first. Retreats to its swamp lair if seriously threatened — it has lived too long to die foolishly.

beholder.name: Beholder
beholder.personality: Paranoid, megalomaniacal, and utterly convinced all other beings — including other beholders — are inferior and threatening.
beholder.tactics: Keeps its antimagic cone aimed at the most dangerous spellcaster. Fires multiple eye rays per round targeting different threats. Uses Charm Ray, Fear Ray, and Disintegrate Ray in rotation. Stays hovering out of melee reach. Never willingly retreats from its lair.

lich.name: Lich
immunities: bludgeoning piercing slashing from nonmagical weapons
lich.personality: An archmage who traded life for immortality. Coldly logical, endlessly patient, considers all others as test subjects.
lich.tactics: Opens with Disrupt Life to damage all living creatures in range. Uses legendary actions to cast spells between rounds. Targets concentration spells first to prevent counterspells. Uses Paralyzing Touch on approaching melee fighters. Returns via phylactery if destroyed.

pit-fiend.name: Pit Fiend
pit-fiend.personality: A supreme devil general who commands absolute loyalty through fear and contract. Every action is calculated for maximum domination.
pit-fiend.tactics: Opens with Wall of Fire to divide the battlefield. Uses Multiattack (mace + tail + claw + bite) on the paladin or most dangerous holy warrior. Casts Fear on grouped enemies. Summons lesser devils when below half HP. Retreats to Avernus rather than die outside its plane.

rat.name: Rat
rat.personality: Tiny and skittish. Attacks only when cornered or as part of a swarm.
rat.tactics: Bites and flees. In groups, swarms the weakest target.

bat.name: Bat
bat.personality: A fluttering nuisance in the dark. Bites when startled; flees at the first sign of real danger.
bat.tactics: Swoops in for a quick bite using its flight speed advantage, then retreats out of reach.

poisonous-snake.name: Poisonous Snake
poisonous-snake.personality: A defensive reptile that strikes when threatened and delivers a potentially lethal dose of venom.
poisonous-snake.tactics: Strikes quickly with its venomous bite then retreats. Relies on poison to weaken prey over time.

swarm-of-rats.name: Swarm of Rats
swarm-of-rats.personality: A frenzied mass of gnawing rodents that overwhelms prey through sheer numbers.
swarm-of-rats.tactics: Engulfs the nearest creature and bites relentlessly. Splits around obstacles. Retreats when below half HP.

tribal-warrior.name: Tribal Warrior
tribal-warrior.personality: A fierce warrior of a primitive tribe who fights to defend territory and prove worth to the chieftain.
tribal-warrior.tactics: Throws spear at range then closes to melee. Flanks with allies when possible. Retreats if the tribe is routed.

cultist.name: Cultist
features: Dark Devotion (advantage on saves vs charm/fright)
cultist.personality: A zealot willing to die for their dark patron. Fanatical but poorly trained.
cultist.tactics: Rushes enemies without strategy, relying on numbers. Screams praises to their patron while fighting.

guard.name: Guard
guard.personality: A professional town guard — not looking for a fight, but trained to handle one if it comes.
guard.tactics: Calls for backup first. Holds position and uses spear to keep attackers at bay. Surrenders or flees if outmatched.

crocodile.name: Crocodile
crocodile.personality: A patient aquatic ambush predator that lurks motionless until prey comes within reach.
crocodile.tactics: Lurks near water's edge. Lunges to bite and grapple prey, then drags it underwater to drown. Fights until prey is dead.

brown-bear.name: Brown Bear
brown-bear.personality: A massive territorial predator — mostly avoids humans but will charge without warning when threatened or protecting cubs.
brown-bear.tactics: Charges the nearest threat. Uses multiattack (bite + claws) every round. Fights until it or its enemy cannot continue.

ghast.name: Ghast
ghast.personality: A more powerful and cunning variant of the ghoul, reeking of decay and driven by insatiable hunger.
ghast.tactics: Uses Stench to sicken nearby foes, then multiattacks with claw-claw-bite to paralyze victims. Focuses bites on paralyzed targets for auto-crits.

gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gargoyle.personality: A malevolent stone creature that lurks motionless as decoration before striking. Delights in the terror it causes.
gargoyle.tactics: Waits in False Appearance (stone statue form) until prey is adjacent, then attacks. Uses flight to stay out of reach between attacks. Never retreats.

ogre-zombie.name: Ogre Zombie
ogre-zombie.personality: A massive shambling ogre corpse driven by nothing but the dark magic animating it. No tactics, no mercy, no stopping.
ogre-zombie.tactics: Shuffles toward the nearest creature and swings its morningstar. Does not prioritize targets. Undead Fortitude may keep it standing past zero HP.

minotaur-skeleton.name: Minotaur Skeleton
minotaur-skeleton.personality: The animated bones of a minotaur — still terrifying in size and strength, now coupled with undead relentlessness.
minotaur-skeleton.tactics: Charges straight at the nearest foe to trigger its gore attack, then follows up with greataxe. Attacks the same target until it falls.

wererat.name: Wererat
immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical non-silvered weapons
wererat.personality: A cunning, paranoid lycanthrope that prefers to fight dirty. Operates in packs of thieves and scavengers.
wererat.tactics: Fights in hybrid form when cornered. Uses bite to spread lycanthropy. Flees to rat form to escape if outmatched.

knight.name: Knight
knight.personality: A disciplined warrior sworn to a code. Honorable in battle, never strikes a surrendered foe, but utterly lethal when fighting.
knight.tactics: Opens with crossbow if distance allows. Uses multiattack each round in melee. Protects allies and challenges the most dangerous enemy to single combat.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.personality: A grizzled warrior who has survived dozens of battles through skill, cunning, and ruthlessness.
veteran.tactics: Assesses the battlefield before charging. Uses multiattack and coordinates with allies. Knows when to press and when to fall back.

ettin.name: Ettin
features: Two Heads (advantage on Wis saves, can't be surprised)
ettin.personality: A quarrelsome two-headed giant whose heads argue constantly but unite in combat. Brutal and territorial.
ettin.tactics: Charges into melee and uses both weapon attacks every round. Two heads means it rarely gets surprised. Targets the heaviest armored enemy to establish dominance.

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.personality: A chaotic fusion of lion, goat, and dragon — violent by nature and impossible to reason with.
chimera.tactics: Opens with Fire Breath if available on clustered enemies. Then charges using all three melee attacks per round. Focuses one target until dead, then moves to the next.

medusa.name: Medusa
features: Petrifying Gaze (DC 14 Con, petrified after 2 fails)
medusa.personality: A bitter, cursed creature who turns intruders to stone. Cunning and proud, it turns its lair into a gallery of frozen victims.
medusa.tactics: Keeps distance to use Petrifying Gaze each round. Fires poisoned longbow at non-gazing targets. Uses snake hair on anyone who closes to melee. Avoids her own reflection.

cloaker.name: Cloaker
cloaker.personality: An ambush predator that mimics cloaks and capes. Intelligent enough to lure prey and coordinate with other aberrations.
cloaker.tactics: Drops from ceiling onto isolated targets. Bites to grapple, then wraps around the victim to bite each turn. Uses Moan to disorient those trying to help. Tail-slaps nearby targets.

spirit-naga.name: Spirit Naga
spirit-naga.personality: A malevolent serpentine spirit that craves power and serves evil gods. Ancient and vindictive.
spirit-naga.tactics: Opens with Lightning Bolt on clustered enemies. Uses Hold Person to restrain fighters, then bites paralyzed targets. Falls back on bite when spell slots are exhausted.

young-red-dragon.name: Young Red Dragon
young-red-dragon.personality: Young but already imperious and territorial. Burns first, asks questions never. Covets treasure obsessively.
young-red-dragon.tactics: Opens with Fire Breath on the largest cluster. Multiattacks the most dangerous target. Uses flight to stay above melee when advantageous. Retreats to lair if bloodied.

bone-devil.name: Bone Devil
bone-devil.personality: A cruel inquisitor and torturer of the Nine Hells, loyal to Dispater. Takes sadistic pleasure in pain.
bone-devil.tactics: Uses sting to poison the most dangerous fighter, then claws them to death. Commands lesser devils tactically. Fights without mercy until destroyed or ordered to retreat.

horned-devil.name: Horned Devil
horned-devil.personality: A front-line warrior of Hell, powerful and utterly merciless. Obeys superiors but bullies those below.
horned-devil.tactics: Charges into melee and hits with fork-fork-tail each round. Uses Hurl Flame at range. Knocks targets prone with its tail for easy follow-up attacks. Never retreats.

erinyes.name: Erinyes
features: Hellish Weapons (extra 3d8 poison on each hit)
erinyes.personality: A fallen angel turned devil — beautiful, remorseless, and utterly ruthless. Carries a rope of entanglement.
erinyes.tactics: Opens with longbow from above, poisoning targets. Closes to longsword multiattack once enemies are weakened. Uses entanglement on spellcasters.

purple-worm.name: Purple Worm
purple-worm.personality: A mindless engine of destruction that burrows through stone and swallows creatures whole.
purple-worm.tactics: Surfaces beneath targets for bite attacks (to swallow) and tail sting (for massive poison damage). Swallowed creatures take acid damage each round inside. Does not retreat — it is a force of nature.

adult-blue-dragon.name: Adult Blue Dragon
adult-blue-dragon.personality: A supremely arrogant ruler of desert skies. Demands tribute, obliterates those who refuse, and collects both gold and information.
adult-blue-dragon.tactics: Opens with Lightning Breath on a line of enemies. Multiattacks the most dangerous target. Uses Legendary Actions between rounds. Targets ranged attackers and spellcasters with priority.

adult-black-dragon.name: Adult Black Dragon
adult-black-dragon.personality: Ancient, cunning, and hateful. Rules over swamps and ruins, enjoying the slow corruption of everything it touches.
adult-black-dragon.tactics: Opens with Acid Breath, then multiattacks the highest-threat target. Retreats into murky water to recharge, re-emerging to strike. Uses Legendary Actions to stay aggressive between rounds.

iron-golem.name: Iron Golem
iron-golem.personality: A massive, indestructible construct of living metal. Obeys without question. Cannot be reasoned with.
iron-golem.tactics: Walks directly at targets and uses Multiattack (2 slams) each round. Uses Poison Breath when available on grouped enemies. Fire spells heal it. Nothing stops it until its creator commands otherwise.

kraken.name: Kraken
features: Multiattack (3 tentacles + 1 bite or 3 tentacles + lightning storm)
kraken.personality: An ancient, godlike entity of the deep seas. Patient beyond mortal comprehension, wrathful when disturbed. It views mortals as insects.
kraken.tactics: Uses Tentacle attacks to grapple and restrain multiple targets simultaneously. Uses Fling to hurl grappled creatures into other enemies or walls. Lightning Storm hits all non-tentacle targets. Uses Ink Cloud to blind enemies trying to flee. It does not flee — it is the apex of the ocean.
